title: MLA Akhil Gogoi holds sit-in over flood compensation in Guwahati
seoTitle: Guwahati sit-in over flood aid compensation

tea.why: Protesters demanded adequate financial compensation and a CBI inquiry for families affected by devastating floods in eastern districts.
tea.want: A one-time interim assistance of Rs 15,000 for affected families, an additional Rs 10,000, and a CBI inquiry into the causes of the flood.
tea.changed: Oct 15: MLA Akhil Gogoi called off his 13-day sit-in after ministers assured him of meeting demands regarding flood compensation.

summary: Raijor Dal MLA Akhil Gogoi launched an indefinite sit-in on the State Assembly premises in Guwahati starting October 2, 2026, demanding adequate financial relief for families affected by floods in Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat, and Golaghat districts. The legislator stated that no monetary assistance had reached most affected families months after the disaster. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma initially stated that disbursement was intentionally delayed to prevent the opposition MLA from claiming political credit. Following negotiations with state cabinet ministers Keshab Mahanta and Pijush Hazarika, who visited the protest site, the sit-in was called off after the government agreed to provide the requested interim assistance for listed families and instituted a high-level inquiry committee.
demands: One-time interim assistance of Rs 15,000 for affected families in Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat, and Golaghat districts
Additional Rs 10,000 for flood-hit people of Sivasagar and Charaideo
CBI inquiry into the causes of the flood
response: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma initially stated disbursement was delayed so the opposition MLA could not claim credit. Later, cabinet ministers Keshab Mahanta and Pijush Hazarika met the protester, assuring him of interim financial assistance and a high-level inquiry committee.

updates.text: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma stated that flood relief disbursement was intentionally delayed to prevent the opposition MLA from claiming credit.
MLA Akhil Gogoi called off his 13-day sit-in following discussions with state ministers who assured him of compensation measures and a high-level inquiry.
